sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Crumlin" (cons 490). In 1979 Dublin Corporation was elected in eleven numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1979 (S.I. No. 41 of 1979); this is Dublin City Number Eight, the area named for Crumlin, filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
